headline_seed: Live updates: Iran’s president says ‘we will never bow our head’ to Trump in defiant UN speech - CNN
draft_text:
Trump at the UN: deal with Iran or "annihilate" it.
CNBC and ABC News report the US and Iran have been in conflict nearly seven months, with the Strait of Hormuz — carrying roughly a fifth of global oil — as the central flashpoint.
